description: Source code for a command-line interface (CLI) tool that initializes various project types based on user input. It handles argument parsing, project configuration creation, template generation, and JSON output formatting.

classes.name: ProjectConfig
classes.description: Configuration object for project parameters such as name, version, description, author, type, output path, and additional parameters.

classes.name: ProjectType
classes.description: Enumeration or class representing different project types, with a method to parse from string.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: Main class responsible for creating project templates and initializing projects.

classes.name: TemplateInitInfo
classes.description: Data structure containing initialization commands, environment info, scripts, and other template-related data.

methods.name: parse_parameters
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string of key=value pairs into a dictionary with appropriate data types.

methods.name: create_project_config
methods.description: Creates a ProjectConfig object from CLI arguments.

methods.name: make_path_absolute
methods.description: Converts a relative path to an absolute path based on a base directory.

methods.name: template_init_info_to_dict
methods.description: Converts TemplateInitInfo object into a dictionary with absolute paths for serialization.

methods.name: output_json
methods.description: Formats and prints the output JSON with success status, message, and template configuration.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that parses arguments, creates project configuration, generates templates, and outputs results.
